caroline.description: Quidditch, single player: start a match as one of the seven players of Gryffindor or Slytherin against the AI, pause, resume, and see how it goes

tools.name: status
tools.description: What the app shows: the screen, the camera, the setup and, in a match, the time, the score, your player (place, what it holds, what A and X do now), the balls and the Snitch

tools.name: start_match
tools.description: Starts a match at once: team gryffindor or slytherin; player a slot 0..6 (0 Keeper, 1-3 Chasers, 4-5 Beaters, 6 Seeker), a role or a name; difficulty easy, normal or hard; seed for a match that can be played again

tools.name: pause
tools.description: Pauses the match and shows the pause menu

tools.name: resume
tools.description: Goes on with a paused match
